subject: SIG/CAIQ: BCP scenario footprint + RTO/RPO evidence
messages:
From: Lisa Harper <lisa@secassure.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Albatross Bank Compliance <compliance@albatrossbank.com>, SecAssure Intake <intake@secassure.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG/CAIQ - BCP evidence request (initial ask)

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Albatross (our mutual customer) requested a concise package for the SIG/CAIQ review focused specifically on Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery. For the scope below, can you provide artifacts and short attestation notes? Target deadline: COB Feb 16 if possible.

Scope and asks:
- RTO/RPO matrix per service (primary + failover) with observed recovery runs (timestamps)
- Tabletop exercise summary and the runbook excerpt used in the exercise (redact PII)
- KV-cache warm-up/restore traces showing prefix warm times and any cold-start latency numbers
- Evidence of the last failover (simulated or live) including responsible on-call and play-by-play log snippets
- SIG/CAIQ mapping sheet with where the artifacts live (index)

Attachments are fine and a single zip is OK. Please flag any items that are still in draft.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Harper
Senior Assessor, SecAssure
lisa@secassure.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Harper <lisa@secassure.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ - BCP evidence request (initial ask)

Hi Lisa — thanks, and noted. We'll assemble a focused package and confirm the items below. Owners and quick status: 

- RTO/RPO matrix per service (owner: Markus) — will include observed timestamps from the last three rehearsals and a CSV export.
- Tabletop exercise summary + runbook excerpt (owner: Naomi) — we will provide a redacted excerpt and a one-page narrative of the tabletop scenario.
- KV warm-up traces (owner: Markus) — raw logs + a short explanation of the pre-warm strategy.
- Failover evidence (owner: Ben) — sanitized log snippets, PagerDuty incident id, and on-call names.
- SIG/CAIQ mapping index (owner: Chloe) — XLSX with links to each artifact.

We expect to deliver a ZIP with the files and an index by end of day Feb 15 PT to give your team time to review. If Albatross needs quicker turnaround, let me know which items are highest priority.

I will attach a short attestation statement for each artifact (who produced it and that it's the same material we use in audits).

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

--

Chloe / team — prepping artifacts. Quick technical notes so the index is accurate: 

1) RTO/RPO matrix: attached file redwood_rto_rpo_matrix_2028-02-14.csv (columns: service_id, primary_region, failover_region, declared_rto_mins, measured_recovery_mins, measured_rpo_seconds, most_recent_test_ts). The measured_recovery_mins are from automated rehearsals run on 2028-01-18, 2028-01-31, 2028-02-08.

2) KV warm-cache traces: kv_warm-cache-traces_20280214.log — these are collector traces from the runtime showing KV replication, prefix fetch, and time-to-warm per prefix. Note: we redact user identifiers but preserve prefix keys and timings for audit. Expect pre-warm times under 12s for critical prefixes after recent batching changes.

3) Failover evidence: tabletop_runbook_excerpt_redacted.pdf plus a small log snippet set (we'll include pagerduty id: PD-78421 and the sanitized trace blocks). Ben will attach the incident timeline.

Where artifacts live: staging S3 (s3://redwood-evidence/albatross/2028-02-14) — I'll provide a short-lived read link in the index XLSX.

I'll add short bullet attestation lines to each artifact metadata noting the owner, generation method, and whether the file is production archival or a staging export for review.

-Markus
Director, Reliability Engineering

Summary of failover snippet (PD-78421):
- Feb 08 02:03 UTC simulated failover (planned rehearsal) triggered via orchestration job ORC-992.
- Automatic traffic shift completed in 4m 08s; service-specific warm-up completed in 9s for core embeddings cache.
- On-call: A. Reyes (SRE) — phone handoff completed at 02:11 UTC.
- Post-run verification: consistency checks passed (key counts matched).

Note on timestamps: the measured_recovery_mins in the matrix were computed from orchestration job start -> verification completion, which is why some entries show 4m rather than 0m — that is expected.

Ping me if SecAssure needs log sanitization in a different format.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Technical Program Manager, Reliability

From: Lisa Harper <lisa@secassure.com>

Chloe / Ben / Markus — received the zip and the index, thanks. A couple quick clarifying questions after a first pass: 

1) In the CSV the measured_recovery_mins for the embeddings service read as 4 (matches your note), but the kv_warm-cache-traces show a 9s warm for the same prefix. Can you add a one-line note in the index explaining the difference (4m orchestration + 9s warm vs. what Albatross expects as application-visible RTO)?

2) For the tabletop excerpt, can Naomi confirm the exact set of templates used and whether the same runbook is used for Dedicated (reserved) customers vs Hosted? That will determine if we mark the artifact as "shared template" or "customer-scoped" in the SIG mapping.

If you can reply with those two clarifications in-line we can close the SIG mapping. Otherwise the artifacts look complete.

Best,
Lisa
